name: delivery-handshake-local-fallback
description: An accepted session_start whose body is empty, not JSON, not an object, or carries a missing, empty, or non-string sessionId falls back to the local session id (Dart _applyLifecycleResponse).

steps.note: a session whose session_start response has an empty body
accepted; the local id becomes the collector session id
events are stamped with the local session id
nothing left to drain: session_end goes out with the local id
a session whose session_start response has a body that is not JSON
accepted; the local id becomes the collector session id
events are stamped with the local session id
nothing left to drain: session_end goes out with the local id
a session whose session_start response has a JSON body that is not an object
accepted; the local id becomes the collector session id
events are stamped with the local session id
nothing left to drain: session_end goes out with the local id
a session whose session_start response has no sessionId
accepted; the local id becomes the collector session id
events are stamped with the local session id
nothing left to drain: session_end goes out with the local id
a session whose session_start response has an empty sessionId
accepted; the local id becomes the collector session id
events are stamped with the local session id
nothing left to drain: session_end goes out with the local id
a session whose session_start response has a sessionId that is not a string
accepted; the local id becomes the collector session id
events are stamped with the local session id
nothing left to drain: session_end goes out with the local id
